ai_summary: Almondz Global Securities Limited's subsidiary, AGICL, reported a substantial 214% growth in new orders, securing Rs. 154 crores in H1 FY2026-27, which propelled its total order book past Rs. 400 crores. This significant increase, stemming from diverse domestic infrastructure consultancy mandates to be executed over three years, provides strong multi-year revenue visibility and is expected to materially contribute to the parent company's consolidated earnings. No red flags are evident, with orders noted as standard, non-related party transactions from government entities.
